Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an excessive firm mass of scar tissue that grows beyond the original wound, not a fine hairline scar.

Q9037.reason: Tracheostomy is commonly used to help wean patients from prolonged mechanical ventilation; it does not repair paralyzed vocal cords.
